label: email_reply
text: Thank you for thinking of me and for sharing the details of the role. After reviewing the offer, I need to decline, as the salary is below what I’m looking for at this stage. I enjoyed learning more about the opportunity and appreciate the time you took to reach out. Please keep me in mind for future roles that might be a stronger match.
